items.title: Ether treasury firm BTCS warns SEC its $54 million Aave loan could be liquidated
items.summary: BTCS cut its reported Aave debt by about $10 million in ten days, but falling ether prices are keeping its collateral under pressure.

items.title: Fairmint plans tokenized stock venue on Canton, Ethereum under SEC experiment
items.summary: The firm is the latest to join in building blockchain-based stock markets under the agency’s five-year "innovation exemption" for tokenized trading.

items.title: ETFs de Ether perdem força antes de teste do suporte em US$ 2.540
items.summary: Ethereum acumula alta de 7,90% em sete dias, mas vê entradas em ETFs desacelerarem e precisa defender suporte entre US$ 2.530 e US$ 2.540.
